interiorStyle.description: Weathered modular modern-complex architecture with corroded gray metal, repeated structural bays, warm aging service lights, long sightlines, and consistent adjacent-room topology.

light.intent: Clear later-morning or afternoon light with readable weathered surfaces and a cool ocean horizon.

crepuscular.intent: Day-one dusk: warm low sun at the horizon, cool structure shadows, and practical lights beginning to read.

dark.intent: Moonlit silhouette with navigable edges and strong warm practical-light contrast.
